en.t: The teacher must be suffering terribly too.

units.source_text: 我想，"他一定是绞尽脑汁才想出这一招来的。

en.t: I thought, "He must have racked his brains to come up with this move.
Right now he truly hates me.

units.source_text: 大概老师不是憎恨照片，而是这张照片通使他在自己的寺庙里也不得不避忌地人的耳目，

en.t: Most likely, it was not the photograph itself that the teacher hated, but the fact that it forced him, even in his own temple, to avoid people's eyes,

units.source_text: 趁无人的当儿蹑足经过走廊，来到一次也不曾来过的弟子房间，

en.t: to take advantage of a moment when no one was around, creep down the corridor on tiptoe, and come to a disciple's room he had never once visited before,

units.source_text: 简直像犯罪似地打开了我的书桌抽屉，露出了一副卑鄙的嘴脸。

en.t: to open my desk drawer almost like a criminal, revealing a base and contemptible face.

units.source_text: 如今老师已有充分理由憎恨我了。"

en.t: Now the teacher had ample reason to hate me."
